response.overview: Life We've Known is a short documentary exploring Matrescence — the profound physical, emotional, hormonal, and social transformation of becoming a mother. Through the eyes of music producer Elise Reitze-Swensen, the film follows the creation of her ambitious 20-track album inspired by early motherhood, capturing both the beauty and intensity of identity, creativity, and parenthood.  Blending intimate storytelling with immersive music-making, the documentary examines how motherhood reshaped Elise’s artistic practice, revealing unexpected connections between parenting and creative expression: finding confidence in chaos, creating within fleeting moments of time, and embracing imperfection as part of both art and motherhood itself. Through music, collaboration, and vulnerability, Life We’ve Known offers a deeply personal portrait of transformation, resilience, and finding a new voice.
response.title: Life We've Known
